description_zh: WeRide 车辆以 6 mph 在 Northwestern Parkway 上尝试 U 形转弯（左转）时，后方一辆雪佛兰 Cruze 以 23 mph 接近，避让不及导致右前侧擦撞前车左前保险杠。

source_snippets: a WeRide vehicle (Car1) was attempting to make a u-turn at 6 mph on Northwestern parkway. During the u-turn maneuver, a white chevy cruze (Car 2) traveling at 23 mph, having just made a right turn off of Walsh Ave., approached from behind on northwestern parkway. Car 2 steered left just before the impact but still clipped the front left side bumper of Car 1 with its (car2's) right side.
evidence.reason: 选取正在进行 U 形转弯的 Car1 为 ego，测试其转弯决策；后方快速接近的 Car2 为 NPC，发生类似追尾的侧面碰撞，可用 rear_hit 行为表达。天气晴朗、白天，控制信号未见说明，设为 unknown。
